t: learn/teach absorbed into wakeup/closeout — standalone commands removed
description: Removed /wai-learn and /wai-teach as user-exposed commands. Learn (teaching ceremony + lug routing) now runs inline in wakeup Step 3a. Teach (outbox delivery) now runs as closeout Step 9 before git commit. Protocol is simpler: pull on wake, push on close. Root cause: commands were never invoked in practice; outbox signals were accumulating across sessions because /wai-teach was always a deferred follow-on.
